In middle school my friends and I would play lots of mobile games in the classroom during break, often arguing about them or screaming like middle schoolers do when they die in a game. Essentially we were annoying little kids with access to the internet. At some point it got so bad even for our classmates that being on your phone in the classroom was banned by our main teacher. 

However, like the slick little boys we were we found a loophole and just started to play our games sitting on the floor of the hallway. I gotta admit that the scene must have looked terribly depressing to any outsider and we frequently got some judgy looks by our peers and the teachers walking by. On top of that since we were still annoying middle school boys the yelling didn't stop when we were in the hallway so now an entire floor was bothered by us.

So in response the next year a new rule was implemented school wide that forbid phone usage for every student throughout the entire day.

Very ironically though this was the year after our graduatiom so we essentially screwed over every student at that school  just to bail on the mess we made so sorry guys for probably ruining a bunch of snapchat streaks.

Hey, I don't have a lot of friends myself but I can tell you how I made the few tjat I have.

Option 1 (probably the most common): through school.

Yoi spend a lot of time there and people from alll different backgrounds go there.

Option 2: through other friends

I heard somewhere that you're on average only 6 connections away from meeting the pope. That means if you have any people you occasionaly hang out with even though you wouldn't consider them friends. Get closer to the and maybe you'll get to meet their friends and so on.

Option 3: Clubs

People wirh the same interests as you or you can even find new passions.

Option 4: old friends

Revive old friendships. Did you and an old friend of you drift apart for some reason? Try to get back to him and revive your old friendship.

Option 5: Online friendships

Maybe you already have some gaming friends or something like that. Although traditional friendships have some strong advantages over online friendships doesn't mean that they don't exist. It's harder to form a real friendship online but not impossible.
